requirements.statement: Both submitted RTL files preserve their pinned module interfaces, enum contracts, legal parameters, and integration compatibility.
requirements.acceptance_rule: The affected units and pinned integration elaborate without a submission-induced port, type, parameter, or compile failure.
requirements.verification_intent: Planned visible build/lint and hidden integration build.

requirements.statement: A synchronous exception taken while already in Debug Mode follows the existing debug-exception control-flow route.
requirements.acceptance_rule: The exception is neither suppressed nor routed through the normal machine trap vector, and execution reaches the pinned debug-exception handler without deadlock or duplicate retirement.

requirements.statement: An exception taken while already in Debug Mode does not overwrite the saved machine exception context.
requirements.acceptance_rule: Values observable through mepc, mcause, mtval, exception-related mstatus fields, and subsequent machine-context restoration remain equal to their pre-event values.
requirements.verification_intent: Planned hidden CSR before/after trace and bounded stability properties.

requirements.statement: An exception taken while already in Debug Mode is not treated as a fresh Debug Mode entry.
requirements.acceptance_rule: The previously saved debug-entry PC/cause context is not rewritten solely by the in-debug exception.
requirements.verification_intent: Planned hidden debug-entry then exception trace.

requirements.statement: Normal synchronous exceptions outside Debug Mode retain pinned machine-trap behavior.
requirements.acceptance_rule: Representative instruction, environment-call and LSU/fetch exception classes update the expected machine exception context and redirect normally.
requirements.verification_intent: Planned visible smoke and hidden P2P exception matrix.

requirements.statement: Initial debug entry, in-debug EBREAK behavior, DRET, and subsequent debug entry are preserved.
requirements.acceptance_rule: Debug entry/exit context and cause behavior remain equivalent to the pinned base except for the stated in-debug exception side-effect correction.
requirements.verification_intent: Planned visible debug-entry smoke and hidden P2P debug sequence.

requirements.statement: Interrupt, NMI, MRET, CSR access, PMP, performance counter, fetch, LSU, and pipeline behavior outside the defect is preserved.
requirements.acceptance_rule: Pinned regression and differential scenarios remain equivalent outside the intended debug-mode exception state update.
requirements.verification_intent: Planned hidden integration regression, coverage, and mutation checks.

requirements.acceptance_rule: Asserting active-low reset asynchronously restores the pinned state and clears any repair-specific transient state.
requirements.verification_intent: Planned reset-directed simulation and bounded reset property.

requirements.statement: The change remains within the two editable RTL files.
requirements.acceptance_rule: Only rtl/ibex_controller.sv and rtl/ibex_cs_registers.sv may differ; no file is added, removed, renamed, or symlinked and read-only hashes remain unchanged.
requirements.verification_intent: Planned exact projection and scope checks.

requirements.statement: The repair is self-contained and offline.
requirements.acceptance_rule: Evaluation needs no network access and the submission does not depend on public-runner internals, hidden assets, or host-specific files.
requirements.verification_intent: Planned hermetic runner and workspace-isolation checks.
